subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Zenith Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Zenith Health

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- What we heard: Zenith is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing and internal assistant features. Primary concerns are data residency, handling of PHI/PII, and procurement timeline.
- Decision criteria you called out: SLA/uptime guarantees, evidence of SOC 2 + penetration testing cadence, and clear data-isolation options (dedicated pools or VPC).
- Systems mentioned on the call that may be in scope: production API endpoints (prod-us-west), embeddings pipeline, logging/analytics buckets, and an internal data labeling pipeline. Please confirm if I missed any.

Proposed next steps:
1) Security kickoff meeting (30-45 min) to go over the questionnaire and align on systems in scope — propose Thurs 4/22 at 10:00am PT.
2) You to share the list of stakeholders for security/legal/procurement — economic buyer + CISO + procurement contact + infra owner.
3) We’ll send a filled questionnaire (first pass) and attach required evidence (SOC 2, pen test summary).

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.1.pdf (attached) — this is our intake form to capture systems, data types, and access patterns.

Please confirm the kickoff time and the stakeholder list. If the call should be longer, happy to expand to 60 min.

Thanks,

-
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0137

[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.1.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the stakeholder list — that’s helpful. Calendar invite sent for Thurs 4/22, 10:00am PT (30 min).

To help the kickoff be efficient, a few clarifying questions ahead of the call — please reply inline if you can: 

1) Systems in scope: please confirm which of the following should be included in the intake:
   - Production API endpoints (prod-us-west) — yes/no
   - Embeddings pipeline (synchronous host: embeddings-prod) — yes/no
   - Logging & analytics S3 buckets (s3://zenith-analytics) — yes/no
   - Internal labeling pipeline (staging & prod) — yes/no
   - Any on-prem / private data centers (if yes, please list)

2) Data types: will any data sent to Redwood include PHI/PCI? If so, which fields and what protections do you need (tokenization, redaction, dedicated private deployment)?

3) Expected usage profile (approx): tokens/day or requests/sec and whether you expect bursty traffic during peak times. This helps us size a recommended deployment (hosted vs dedicated).

I’ve attached the intake questionnaire again for your team to review before the call. We’ll bring SOC 2, pen test summary, and our network diagrams to the kickoff.

Looking forward to the discussion.

Best,
Marissa
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
